heading: Weddings at Sane Living Center
intro:
Say your vows beneath the stained glass, toast under the olive tree and string lights in the Secret Garden, then dim the lights and dance until midnight in the soundproof Auditorium. No neighbors to wake, and no last call at ten.

Your guests walk from their hotels to the ceremony and on to downtown dinner, and the wedding party gets ready in a private room down the hall. Bring in the vendors you love and make the whole day yours, at one address in the heart of Ojai.
highlights: Soundproof auditorium in downtown Ojai — celebrations can carry on well into the night
Outdoor space also available to rent
Conference Room or Annex for getting ready / breakout space
pricingText: Wedding packages starting at $1,500. Each quote is based on your guest count and needs. Call (805) 646-6000 for a custom quote.
cateringPolicy: Outside caterers are welcome, and you can even have a food truck set up in the Center's private parking lot. Caterers must provide proof of insurance and follow the venue's load-in, cleanup, and house rules.
alcoholPolicy: Clients may bring their own alcohol (no corkage fee) with their own liquor license/permit. Anyone serving alcohol must carry their own insurance.
availabilityNote: Purple dates on the calendar are not available.
